source.title: Risk-Managed Time-Series Momentum in Crypto Majors: Crash-State De-Risking and Drawdown Control

hypothesis: A fixed 30-day long/cash trend sleeve on crypto majors, with a 15%-drawdown market-state de-risk overlay, retains net Sharpe above one out of sample.
implementation_surface: Spot-executable long/cash strategy using Binance perpetual OHLC as a continuous price proxy; no funding charged because no short/perpetual exposure is required in the intended implementation.
signal: At each UTC day open, each available asset receives 1/7 notional if its cumulative log return over the prior 30 completed UTC days is positive, else cash.
market_overlay: Compute an equal-weight daily index of the seven majors using available assets. If the lagged index is more than 15% below its trailing all-time peak, multiply all target weights by 0.5.
execution: Signals and drawdown state use data through prior completed day; target changes execute at current UTC-day open.
development_gate: net Sharpe >0.80, positive total return, max drawdown <50%
success_gate: OOS net Sharpe >1.0, positive at 25bps one-way, both 2024 and 2025 non-negative, max drawdown <35%, one-day extra execution delay Sharpe >0.8
no_parameter_tuning: L=30 days, drawdown threshold 15%, and de-risk multiplier 0.5 are source-fixed.
